claims.claim: Epiphanius of Salamis was born at Besanduk, near Eleutheropolis, in Judea, after 310 and died in 403.
Epiphanius was the Bishop of Constantia (Salamis), the metropolis of the island of Cyprus.
Epiphanius was a strong defender of orthodoxy and is considered a saint and Church Father.
De Fide is Epiphanius' summary of the catholic faith as he understood it.
The text from which the modern translation is made is Holl's, with notes completed after his death by Hans Lietzmann, and Dummer's reedition.
Epiphanius studied and practiced monasticism in Egypt before returning to found a monastery in Judea.
